about.title: About Bugarin
about.description: Bugarin is a simple health tracking app designed to help you monitor your fitness journey. Track your daily food intake, exercise activities, and weight changes to stay on top of your health goals.
about.foodTrackingDesc: Log meals and track calories and macros
about.personalTargetsDesc: Set and manage your health goals
about.aboutText1: Bugarin is built with the goal of making health tracking simple and accessible. Whether you're looking to lose weight, gain muscle, or just maintain a healthy lifestyle, Bugarin helps you keep track of your progress with ease.
about.aboutText2: All your data is stored locally on your device, ensuring your privacy and keeping your health information secure.
